title: Deploy a model and chat with it
authoredFrom: Lab guide: Deploy your first model in Microsoft Foundry
note: Step text is AI-authored from the lab guide. The match specs below are captured from the live portal and resolved DETERMINISTICALLY by anchor.js — the model never decides what to glow.

steps.say: Let's deploy a model. Start in Deployments — it's in the left navigation.
Now open the model catalogue with Deploy model.
Choose Deploy base model — that's the catalogue of ready-made models.
Search for the model you want. Type gpt-5 here.
There it is. Select the gpt-5 card.
Give the deployment a name. I've put one on your clipboard — paste it in.

steps.note: near:'gpt-5' scopes this to the chosen model's dialog. Without it, a page showing two model cards has two equally-valid Deploy buttons and Rocky correctly refuses to choose.

steps.say: Provisioning now. This takes a moment — I'll wait with you.
Deployed. Let's actually talk to it — open the Playground.
This is the chat box. Type a prompt — anything you like.
steps.type: Explain what an insider risk policy does, in two sentences.
